subject: Web Development
title: jQuery's Graceful Decline
description: Learn jQuery's Graceful Decline in one minute.

hook.text: jQuery solved browser differences. But browsers got better, and the differences vanished.

buildup.text: querySelectorAll, fetch, and classList made native JavaScript as easy as jQuery once was.

discovery.text: Modern frameworks like React rendered the DOM themselves, making jQuery's approach obsolete.

twist.text: jQuery still runs on millions of legacy sites. Removing it would break the old web.

climax.text: It faded not because it failed but because it succeeded — the web absorbed its ideas.

punchline.text: jQuery's best ideas became browser features.

quiz.question: Why did jQuery become less necessary?
